LESSON: OUR ENVIRONMENT

Grade: PP2
Subject: ENVIRONMENTAL ACTIVITIES
Strand: SOCIAL 1.1 Myself By the end of the sub- • Learners sing songs and say poems 1. 
Topic 1.2: Our ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 1: WELCOME

• Today’s class: Our ENVIRONMENT
• How we learn: Teach → Worked example → Try this
• Use point notes. Show working. Then take the quiz.
• Big question: What work is done by different people in school identifying the people by the by people at school?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

1. explain Our ENVIRONMENT
2. give Kenyan examples of Our ENVIRONMENT
3. practise a safe skill for Our ENVIRONMENT

SECTION 3: CLASS STUDY (TEACH → EXAMPLE → TRY)

▸ Our ENVIRONMENT

Teach
• Observe Our ENVIRONMENT in real life (school compound, home, farm).
• Use safe examples only.
• Name → explain → apply.

Worked example
• Fact 1 about Our ENVIRONMENT (in pupil words).
• Fact 2 with a Kenyan example.
• Safe action connected to Our ENVIRONMENT.

Try this
• Draw/label one diagram for Our ENVIRONMENT.
• Write 5 bullet facts about Our ENVIRONMENT.
• Say one safety rule.


SECTION: QUICK EXAMPLES


SECTION: PRACTICE NOW

1. List 8 facts on Our ENVIRONMENT.
2. Teach a friend using only bullet points.

SECTION: WORK TO DO

1. Revision sheet for Our ENVIRONMENT: meaning, diagram, 5 practice questions.

SECTION: THINK ABOUT IT

1. What work is done by different people in school identifying the people by the by people at school?
2. What are the dos and c) appreciate the school with rules and regulations of their don’ts in the class?

SECTION: REMEMBER

• Know Our ENVIRONMENT with examples

• Next: complete the Revision Quiz. Open Answers only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Classroom study notes (Strategy 2)
